title: Human-AI Co-Ideation Across Socio-Technical Configurations: An Interactional Analysis of Planar and Immersive Workspaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.21125v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Remote collaborative platforms increasingly integrate generative AI to support group ideation. These platforms are sociotechnical configurations in which spatial mediation, interaction modality, AI output format, and the mechanisms that make contributions visible to a group co-vary as properties of a deployed system. This paper examines how such configurations shape participants' collaboration and their engagement with AI during creative work. We report a comparative study of two commercially available platforms that instantiate contrasting configurations: a planar shared canvas with text-based AI integration, and an immersive virtual reality workspace with concise AI output embedded in the shared space. Fourteen all-women triads completed a structured ideation task consisting of human-only idea generation, AI-supported idea expansion, and group convergence. translated_title: 跨社会技术配置的人机协同构思：平面与沉浸式工作空间的交互分析
translated_abstract: 远程协作平台日益集成生成式AI以支持群体构思。这些平台属于社会技术配置，其中空间中介方式、交互模态、AI输出格式以及使个体贡献对群体可见的机制，作为已部署系统的属性而共同变化。本文考察了此类配置如何塑造参与者在创造性工作中的协作方式及其与AI的互动。我们报告了一项对两个市售平台的比较研究，这两个平台体现了截然不同的配置：一个是集成了基于文本AI的平面共享画布，另一个是将简洁的AI输出嵌入共享空间的沉浸式虚拟现实工作空间。十四个全女性三人小组完成了一项结构化构思任务，包括纯人类创意生成、AI支持的创意扩展以及群体收敛三个阶段。我们分析了协作模式、对AI生成创意的选择、感知……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对平面共享画布与沉浸式VR工作空间两种平台配置的对比实验，揭示了空间中介、交互模态与AI输出形式等社会技术因素如何共同塑造群体构思过程中的人机协作模式及对AI生成创意的采纳。
en_tdlr: This paper comparatively examines how contrasting socio-technical configurations—a planar canvas with text-based AI versus an immersive VR workspace with embedded AI output—shape group ideation collaboration patterns and participants' engagement with AI-generated ideas.
